exposure: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) parameters (ADC, D, D*, f, MK, MD)
cohort: The study included 109 high-risk patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders.
finding: DWI parameters, particularly the pure diffusion coefficient (D), combined with the number of prior cesarean deliveries, were found to be valuable predictors of adverse maternal outcomes in high-risk PAS patients.
mod_finding: The number of prior cesarean deliveries (CDs) was identified as an independent predictor of adverse maternal outcomes.
